title: Extremely Heart Warming Bitclub Network Real Life Testimonies
description: Nothing much to say, but this video says it all whoever joins Bitclub Network will be financially free, it's a fact! Have you seen how ...

asr.full_text: Eight months after joining Bi Club Network, I managed to buy myself a piece of land in Vanmureton. And then I put electric fence, I did chicken houses, I am doing eggs. That is my face business that I opened through Bi Club network. Then in December last year I bought myself top of the range parking, the latest number for DRAINGER cash I also bought in an apartment in Bramford End a fleet, five hundred thousand cash, as well and then this year, January I bought myself a brand new tractor Figassent 4X4, 2019 with a trolley with a plow, also in cash. and 2 months back very proud about this achievement I bought myself a home. beautiful home 1.6 million REN house in Northgate 5 bedroom house, two garage, beautiful. With BitLab Network, there is a lot that I have achieved. The first thing I did, I ran home. I told all my family members that I found something that is working and something that is so legit, something that is paying, something that is so good to be true. And, fortunately enough, my family listened to me and became part of the business and all of us started growing financially. As I'm talking now my family is financially free and there's a lot that I've also achieved. I happened to even adopt an orphanage in Southland where I'm able to give the money for grocery service every month. And I happened to even move from that one room to a three-bedroom house which I bought cash. From a taxi and moved to a car from my study bear car I moved again I was able to buy it even me 500 cash so B Club Network has given me life more than anything it's exciting to know that you are a forerunner of something that people are still trying to understand and you are part of the change and part of those people who are leading others to see the future where we are going Just on its own its so fulfilling and it's so touching I've heard people saying that the sky is the limit But one thing for sure BitLab Network has enabled me to be able to see beyond the sky In the next coming achievement in BitLab Network, I see myself as a mega-monster. Because, if there are people that have been able to do it, which is one of my mentors, why not me? So, it's a matter of seeing, if somebody else can do it then I can do it. But, overall, above and above that it's no longer just about me but to also see my fellow Africans achieve what I have achieved. So, it's not only just about me but the people that are in my team and new people that will be coming on board in the business, to see them break out of poverty and to be able to live a life that they always want to live. I am a pro-builder in the business and I am financially free because our Bitcoin network. Everything I own is bought on cash. There was a time when I accumulated enough capital that it took me five years to build our corporate environment, it only took me five years to build in the corporate environment. It only took me five months to build it in this business So I live 100 percent on bitcoins and Bitclub network. My daughter who is four years old she makes more money in Bclub network than most adults that I know and everything that I own is literally cash based. This changed my life. I cannot even describe it totally. I can just tell you that it has changed dramatically. When my salary used to be 10,000 Rand a month before deductions, I now have added one or two zeros to that And that makes a huge difference to anybody's life. So does this really make a difference? Not only for me, but for so many people around me. For the first time in my life, I can make sure that my two grandchilren has got everything that they need to have, whereas in the past I had to ask my daughter to borrow money from her. What a difference! Isn't that what we're supposed to do to help the people around us?
